extension.summary: Retro cable TV from your own library - flip channels, not menus.
extension.description: CableBox 42 turns your Kodi library into a live cable TV lineup. Shows air on a real-time schedule with commercial breaks and bumps from your own clip folders, a scrolling program guide channel, a retro weather channel, static between channels and a channel banner. Lineups build themselves from your library (genres, decades, studios, tags, smart playlists or folders) and can be fine-tuned show by show - there is no schedule to compile. Playback uses Kodi's own player, so hardware decoding works exactly as it does for the rest of your library.[CR][CR]Inspired by the FieldStation42 project; not affiliated with it.
extension.disclaimer: Plays only media from your own Kodi library and folders. The optional weather channel uses Kodi's weather service or, if you enter a location, fetches forecasts from open-meteo.com.
extension.news:
v1.4.1 (2026-10-28) - AV1 videos are skipped automatically on boxes that can't decode AV1 in hardware (e.g. ODROID N2), which could freeze or crash Kodi; setting: Automatic / Always skip / Always play - "Check my videos" lists AV1 files per channel and in commercial/bump folders - The guide channel no longer freezes while listings are built; a background helper keeps every channel ready
v1.4.0 (2026-10-28) - Weekly planner: 7-day grid per channel - pin shows to fixed times (e.g. Fridays 8 PM, in order), paint off-air hours, copy/clear days - Pinned shows always start on time; automatic programming fills around them - Off the air: 1950s "Please stand by" test card or color bars, optional sign-off and sign-on clips - Station ID clips per channel, played between programs - CRT-style "CH 03" channel number; optional CRT effect (scanlines, curved glass, phosphor mask, rolling hum bar) - Skins that preview home-menu add-ons (e.g. Marquee) get a "what's on now" channel list instead of opening the menu - Leaving the TV with the Home button now switches CableBox off; it never touches playback it didn't start
v1.3.0 (2026-10-27) - First public release
